{{Quote|Specific information on all major planetary systems may be obtained from the Office of the Surgeon-General on Cloud City|Intergalactic Passport medical information|<ref name="The Star Wars Intergalactic Passport">''[[The Star Wars Intergalactic Passport]]''</ref>}}
The '''Office of the Surgeon-General''' was a government branch on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on Bespin, relating to all medical-related information. Travelers with the ''[[Intergalactic Passport]]'' needed to go to the Office of the Surgeon-General to gain information about any specific information on all major planetary systems during their journey.
